svg.title: Apache Ozone service-based architecture
svg.desc: Service-based architecture for Apache Ozone: five coarse-grained independently deployable JVM services — Storage Container Manager, Ozone Manager, DataNode, S3 Gateway, and Recon server — each with its own Protobuf-over-Hadoop-RPC protocol surface.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do native clients connect to Apache Ozone?')
sendPrompt('How do S3 clients connect to Apache Ozone?')
sendPrompt('What does the Ozone Manager do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Ozone S3 Gateway do?')
g.text: Translates S3 REST → OM + SCM RPC

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Storage Container Manager do in Ozone?')

g.text: Store actual container data · serve client reads and writes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does a DataNode store in Apache Ozone?')
sendPrompt('How do DataNode pipelines work in Ozone?')
sendPrompt('How do clients read and write to DataNodes in Ozone?')
sendPrompt('What does the Ozone Recon server provide?')
g.text: Observability · analytics · passive copy of cluster state — separately deployed JVM process

svg.text: Each service: separate JVM process · Protobuf-over-Hadoop-RPC surface · deployed and scaled independently
